notes.title: QUICK HOTFIX - Showing "Already Bought" if a player hasn't bought the item yet.
notes.content: Luckily this patch is <30MB! Some were experiencing not being able to purchase an item, receiving the message "Already Bought Item", despite not having it.

notes.title: Extending Ep.1 Part 2 release date to July 15th, Swapple H Scenes Update June 28
notes.content: [p]After many obstacles over the past 3 weeks—primarily dealing with business and tax matters we've never had experience with, which brought plenty of headaches and confusion—everything has now been sorted! Additionally, we've had a single nagging, game-breaking, bug in Part 2 that we've spent 2 weeks trying to figure out how to resolve, that yesterday we were finally able fix. [/p][p][/p][p]With these obstacles we're back on track with Part 2, however, we ask for 3 more weeks (July 15th), as of writing this, to allow us to finish all of Part 2, and make it great! As a thank-you for your patience, we’ll be releasing an update on June 28th that adds swappable H-scenes![/p]

notes.title: Crash Patch v2 + News on Next Update + Ability to Skip Intro of Episode 1
notes.content:
In the last Crash Patch, some users were experiencing the game crashing loading the Story Mode environment. We lowered the amount of VRAM and RAM that was taken up while switching between the intro of Episode 1 to the Carnival scene, by changing how we loaded it in. And this worked for some users, however, it still wasn't enough for some others. So in this update, after tinkering around, we've been able to reduce the RAM and VRAM of the carnival by around ~25%, which should fix it for the rest, we hope you all enjoy!

[b]HOW TO SKIP THE INTRO:[/b] Additionally, for those that were crashing beforehand, you won't need to go through the intro of Episode 1 again, after pressing "Play Story" once the game loads, simply press K on your keyboard, and it'll skip the introduction!

[b]News On The Next Update:[/b] We intend to add swappable XXX scenes soon for Arcade Mode, before Episode 1 fully comes out June 26th, though we're not too sure when it'll be, between 1-2 weeks from now would be our estimate for this ability, so stayed tuned!

notes.title: HOTFIX 0.2.1 - Content Patch
notes.content: The new update has the beginning of Episode 1 content patch, as well as major optimization improvements, and the bug fix with the Customization menu! We're very sorry it came a few hours after release, we had some issues on our end. We hope you all enjoy it, and thank you for playing Haunting Havens and supporting its future!
